title: RAG assistant over media support documentation
problem: Support agents spent too long searching policy PDFs for answers to repeat questions.
approach: chunked policy PDFs by heading and indexed them in a vector database
combined BM25 and dense retrieval and reranked the top results
answered with citations and refused when no passage supported an answer
metrics: cut average handling time by 33%
reached 86% answer accuracy on a 200-question test set

repo.name: docs-qa-service
repo.stack: FastAPI service, hybrid retrieval, Docker image

title: Ticket triage classifier for a logistics help desk
problem: Incoming tickets were routed by hand and often reached the wrong team.
approach: labelled a sample of historical tickets with the support lead
fine-tuned a small transformer and compared it against a TF-IDF baseline
added a confidence threshold so low-confidence tickets still go to a person
metrics: routed 65% of tickets automatically
raised macro-F1 from 0.62 to 0.86

repo.name: ticket-router
repo.stack: training script, evaluation notebook, batch scorer

title: Weekly demand forecasting for a real estate business
problem: Stock planning relied on last year's numbers and missed seasonal swings.
approach: built features from sales history, promotions and holidays
compared gradient-boosted trees with a seasonal naive baseline
scheduled weekly retraining and published forecasts to a shared sheet
metrics: lowered forecast error (MAPE) from 17% to 11%
reduced overstock by about 11%

repo.name: demand-forecast
repo.stack: feature pipeline, model training, weekly job

title: Invoice and form data extraction for a recruiting back office
problem: Staff retyped fields from scanned documents into the ERP.
approach: ran OCR and layout detection on scanned pages
used an LLM with a strict JSON schema to pull fields, with validation rules
sent anything that failed validation to a review queue
metrics: removed about 16 hours of manual entry per week
hit 98% field-level accuracy on the audit sample

title: Visual defect detection on a B2B SaaS production line
problem: Quality checks were manual and inconsistent between shifts.
approach: collected and labelled images from the line cameras
trained an object detection model and tuned it for small defects
exported the model for an edge device next to the line
metrics: caught 96% of defects in the hold-out set
ran at 26 frames per second on the edge box

title: Tool-using LLM agent for e-commerce operations staff
problem: Staff had to look up the same data across three internal systems.
approach: wrapped the internal APIs as tools with typed inputs
built the agent as a graph with a human approval step before any write
logged every tool call for audit
metrics: answered 65% of lookup requests without a person
cut the median lookup from 8 minutes to under 1

repo.name: ops-agent
repo.stack: agent graph, tool definitions, approval step

title: Churn prediction model for a edtech subscription product
problem: The retention team could not tell which accounts were about to leave.
approach: built account-level features from usage and billing events
trained and calibrated a gradient-boosted classifier
explained predictions per account so the team trusted the scores
metrics: reached ROC-AUC of 0.84
helped retention calls save about 11% of flagged accounts

title: Semantic product search for a manufacturing catalogue
problem: Keyword search failed on synonyms and misspellings, so users left.
approach: embedded product titles and descriptions
blended semantic and keyword scores and tuned the weights on click logs
A/B tested the new ranking against the old one
metrics: raised search click-through by 14%
cut zero-result searches by 33%

title: Model deployment and monitoring setup for a hospitality team
problem: Models were retrained by hand on a laptop and nobody noticed drift.
approach: moved training into a reproducible pipeline with experiment tracking
served models behind an API with versioned releases
added drift and data-quality alerts
metrics: cut release time for a new model from 4 days to 2
caught 4 data-quality incidents before they reached users

title: Meeting and call summarisation for a B2B SaaS sales team
problem: Reps wrote call notes by hand and CRM records were thin.
approach: transcribed calls and split them by speaker
prompted an LLM to produce structured notes and next steps
evaluated summaries against notes written by the sales lead
metrics: saved reps about 9 minutes per call
85% of summaries were accepted without edits
